<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard AUR packaging conventions. All three sources are fetched from the project's own upstream repository (GitHub releases and raw.githubusercontent.com for SabreTools/MPF), which is expected and appropriate. The `package()` function performs standard `install` operations to place the prebuilt binary and documentation into the correct filesystem locations. The use of `sha256sums=('SKIP' ...)` is standard practice for VCS-derived and rolling-release sources, as noted in Arch packaging guidelines. No suspicious commands (curl, wget, eval, base64), no network exfiltration, no unexpected file modifications, and no obfuscated code are present.
</details>
